sections.name: Fades & Tapers
sections.description: Low, mid, high, drop and burst fades, and tapers.

looks.title: Low Fade with Textured Top
looks.text: a low fade starting just above the ears, the top left a few inches long and worked into messy texture

looks.title: Mid Fade Crop
looks.text: a mid fade blending up to a short cropped top with a straight blunt fringe

looks.title: High Skin Fade Quiff
looks.text: a high skin fade with a short quiff swept up and back at the front

looks.title: Drop Fade
looks.text: a drop fade curving down behind the ear toward the nape, longer brushed-forward top

looks.title: Burst Fade with Curly Top
looks.text: a burst fade circling the ear, a loose mop of curls on top

looks.title: Taper with Side Part
looks.text: a classic taper at the neckline and sideburns, the top combed into a neat side part

looks.title: Fade with Hard Part
looks.text: a mid fade with a sharp shaved hard part on one side, the top combed over

looks.title: Shadow Fade
looks.text: a soft shadow fade that never goes down to skin, natural and low-key, short textured top

looks.title: Fade with Line Design
looks.text: a high fade with a thin curved line design shaved into the side

looks.title: Skin Fade Pompadour
looks.text: a skin fade on the sides with a tall, glossy pompadour on top

sections.name: Short & Textured
sections.description: Crops, crew cuts and short textured cuts.

looks.title: French Crop
looks.text: a French crop: short textured top pushed forward into a blunt fringe, sides cut close

looks.title: Crew Cut
looks.text: a classic crew cut, slightly longer at the front, short and tidy at the sides

looks.title: Ivy League
looks.text: an Ivy League cut: a longer crew cut with enough length on top for a soft side part

looks.title: High and Tight
looks.text: a high and tight military cut, sides shaved almost to skin, a short flat strip on top

looks.title: Messy Textured Fringe
looks.text: short messy layers with a choppy textured fringe falling over the forehead

looks.title: Spiky Gelled Top
looks.text: short hair gelled up into piecey spikes, sides short

looks.title: Flat Top
looks.text: a flat top: hair on top stood up and cut perfectly level, sides short

looks.title: Butch Cut
looks.text: a butch cut, one even short length all over, slightly longer than a buzz

looks.title: Textured Crop with Taper
looks.text: a short textured crop, matte and tousled, with a clean taper at the neck

looks.title: Buzz with Line-Up
looks.text: a close buzz cut with a razor-sharp line-up at the hairline and temples

sections.name: Classic & Slick
sections.description: Side parts, slick backs, pompadours and quiffs.

looks.title: Gentleman's Side Part

looks.title: Slick Back
looks.text: hair slicked straight back from the forehead with a glossy hold, sides tight

looks.title: Undercut Slick Back
looks.text: a disconnected undercut, the long top slicked back over shaved sides

looks.title: Classic Pompadour
looks.text: a classic pompadour: big volume swept up and back at the front, smooth sides

looks.title: Textured Quiff
looks.text: a modern quiff, the front lifted and swept up with matte texture

looks.title: 1950s Greaser
looks.text: a 1950s greaser look: glossy combed-back hair with a loose curl falling onto the forehead

looks.title: 1920s Slicked Part
looks.text: a 1920s look: hair parted sharply to the side and slicked flat with high shine

looks.title: Wet-Look Waves
looks.text: medium hair combed back in glossy wet-look waves

looks.title: Executive Contour
looks.text: a sharp executive cut, short and precise, side part with every hair in place

looks.title: Comb-Over with Fade
looks.text: a modern comb-over swept to one side over a low fade

sections.name: Medium & Layered
sections.description: Curtains, flow, mullets, wolf cuts and two-block cuts.

looks.title: Curtain Bangs
looks.text: curtains: chin-length hair parted in the middle and falling to frame both sides of the face

looks.title: Hockey Flow
looks.text: flow: medium hair pushed back off the face, curling out at the neck and ears

looks.title: Modern Mullet
looks.text: a modern mullet, short textured top and sides, longer layers left at the back

looks.title: Shaggy Mullet
looks.text: a shaggy mullet with choppy layers, a messy fringe and a long, tousled back

looks.title: Wolf Cut
looks.text: a wolf cut: lots of choppy layers, volume at the crown, wispy ends at the neck

looks.title: Surfer Waves
looks.text: sun-bleached, salt-textured surfer waves to the jaw, effortlessly messy

looks.title: Messy Layers
looks.text: medium hair cut in soft messy layers, tucked behind one ear

looks.title: Emo Fringe
looks.text: a long side-swept fringe covering one eye, short layered back

looks.title: Two-Block Cut
looks.text: a Korean two-block cut: longer, soft top layers falling over shorter undercut sides

looks.title: Comma Hair
looks.text: comma hair: the fringe curled inward into a soft comma shape over the forehead

looks.title: Middle Part Flow
looks.text: shoulder-skimming hair with a middle part, tucked behind the ears

looks.title: Rounded Afro with Shape-Up

looks.title: Short Twist-Out

looks.title: Curly Undercut

looks.title: Shoulder-Length Curls

looks.title: Coils with Temple Fade

looks.title: Curly Mohawk Fade
looks.text: a strip of curls down the middle in a mohawk shape, sides faded

looks.title: Picked-Out Afro

looks.title: Wavy Taper

sections.name: Braids, Locs & Twists
sections.description: Cornrows, box braids, twists and locs for men.

looks.title: Shoulder Box Braids
looks.text: shoulder-length box braids, worn loose or pulled back with a band

looks.title: Two-Strand Twists with Fade

looks.title: Shoulder-Length Locs
looks.text: mature shoulder-length locs, worn loose and swept to one side

looks.title: Dyed-Tip Locs
looks.text: medium locs with the ends dyed a lighter colour, the roots left natural

looks.title: Braided Man Bun

looks.title: Single Plait

sections.description: Man buns, top knots, ponytails and long loose hair.

looks.text: long hair pulled up into a loose man bun at the back of the head, a few strands falling free

looks.title: Top Knot with Undercut
looks.text: a tight top knot over shaved undercut sides

looks.text: the top half of shoulder-length hair tied into a small knot, the rest left loose

looks.title: Long Straight Loose
looks.text: long straight hair past the shoulders, worn loose with a middle part

looks.title: Long Waves
looks.text: long, loose waves past the shoulders, tucked behind one ear

looks.title: Long Curls Loose
looks.text: long, loose curls falling past the shoulders

looks.text: shaved sides with a long braided strip down the centre tied back, a few metal beads
